known_issues.probable_cause: Ageing cell group 9 with higher internal resistance

known_issues.issue: Rapid SoC drop reported by rider
known_issues.probable_cause: SoC estimation drift due to imbalance; BMS SoC not recalibrated

incident_history.symptoms: Rider complaint: SoC dropped from 45% to 8% within 3 km
incident_history.root_cause: BMS SoC drift; cell delta 112 mV at low SoC
incident_history.resolution: Battery pulled to service bench, full charge + 12 hour passive balancing, SoC recalibration via full discharge-charge cycle. Cell delta reduced to 28 mV

incident_history.symptoms: Station flagged cell imbalance warning at end of charge (delta 86 mV)
incident_history.root_cause: Cell group 9 internal resistance 18% above pack average
incident_history.resolution: Balancing repeated; BMS firmware update to 2.6.9 for improved balancing current. Battery placed on watchlist: replace if SoH < 75% or delta > 100 mV again
